evidence_classes.C: statement about source code, cited by file and line

findings.title: Causal ordering is implemented as documented
findings.statement: Per step the runner materializes the predictor-visible window, collects every forecast, advances the world, reveals the target, scores, constructs and appends the complete record, and only then calls update and appends the observation to history.

findings.title: Evaluator-only information is structurally separated
findings.statement: predict(history) and update(history, target) receive noisy observations only. latent_position, bounced, changed, noise_innovation, noise_channel, noise_scale and trial identity are retained in the record for scoring but are never passed to a predictor.
findings.limitation: Structural argument from reading call sites, not an exhaustive taint analysis.

findings.title: Bounce accuracy is programmed reflection, not learned capability
findings.statement: Against arms without the public boundary map the candidate's bounce advantage is total; against the arm with the same map the comparison is decisively negative at p=1.

findings.title: v2.1 required-gate outcomes on the retained confirmation B
The protocol has demonstrably failed a required gate
findings.statement: The first confirmation round under the repaired protocol failed always_online_stability on both independent fresh streams and both exited non-zero, with 13 of 14 gates passing in each. The candidate was repaired on development evidence; no threshold was changed; the failed attempts remain committed.

findings.title: The observation-noise learner has an errors-in-variables structure beyond attenuation
findings.statement: The regressor is phi_1 = (y_t - y_{t-1})/D and the target is z = (y_{t+1} - y_t)/L, so the same observation y_t enters the regressor with +L/D and the target with -1. The regressor/target noise covariance is negative, which pushes the estimated slope past zero rather than merely shrinking it toward zero.

findings.title: Measured batch-OLS displacement weight lands on the sign-flipped noise asymptote
findings.limitation: The scale=0.0 rows are a rank-deficient minimum-norm lstsq artifact and carry no meaning; they are reported rather than suppressed.

findings.title: Noise contamination leaks into the non-displacement features of the live incumbent
findings.statement: Driving the real incumbent through a noisy sinusoidal latent path that never touches a wall, the displacement weight attenuates while the centered-position weight moves by three orders of magnitude and changes sign.

findings.title: The frozen noise-trained state is catastrophic on constant velocity, and scale-independently so
findings.statement: Frozen error is nearly independent of the noise scale, which is the signature of a fixed wrong coefficient rather than of sensor noise. Online updating rescues a bias that noisy training itself created.

findings.title: Baseline competitiveness fails on development point estimates
findings.statement: The learner beats the analytic reflected baseline where the world is hard and loses to it where the world is easy. This is a development point estimate, not a confirmation verdict.
findings.limitation: Development evidence cannot predetermine A/B; it identifies the claim most at risk.

findings.title: The three proposed refinements were numerically inert, so the null search tested nothing
findings.statement: The causal-innovation-clip candidates at 0.25, 0.50 and 1.00 are numerically indistinguishable from the incumbent: the clip never bound at any tested noise scale. No refinement satisfied the preregistered constraints, so the unchanged incumbent was retained as an explicit no-refinement control.
findings.must_not_be_read_as: Evidence that the incumbent is robust to observation noise. The search consisted of one mechanism family that turned out to be inactive on the development grid.

findings.title: Noise-shift and law-change are separated only by predeclared controls
findings.statement: Sensor shifts 0.0005<->0.002 at aligned step 300 and staggered step 340 are crossed with unchanged and changed dynamics. h2 forbids treating detector activity as evidence of a successful law-change response. h0 anticipates that observation noise alone can trigger the incumbent's self-triggered forgetting with no law change.
findings.implication: A scalar residual detector cannot in principle separate a sensor-scale change from a law change; this is the uncertainty the observation-noise phase is least equipped to resolve.
